chars_per_token.source: rough rule of thumb for English text and code; real tokenizers differ by model and content

startup_budget_tokens.unit: estimated tokens loaded before the first message
startup_budget_tokens.source: mstack starting point, a choice and not a platform limit; set your own with --budget

duplicate_min_chars.unit: characters a paragraph needs before a repeat is reported
duplicate_min_chars.source: mstack choice, to skip short lines such as headings
